title: Senior Data Steward
description:
Offre d'Emploi : Senior Data Steward (Center of Expertise Data & AI Governance - Central) 

Notre équipe Data & AI Governance recherche un·e Senior Data Steward (f/m/d) en CDI basé·e à Lille / Paris .

Chez Decathlon, nous croyons au pouvoir du sport pour unir et inspirer. Notre mission : rendre le sport accessible au plus grand nombre, partout dans le monde. Pour y parvenir, la data est au cœur de notre stratégie, guidant chaque décision, de la conception du produit à l'expérience client. Notre défi ? La rendre gouvernée, sûre et exploitable. Tu rejoindras le Data & AI Governance Center of Expertise (CoE), une équipe dynamique de passionné·es, pour transformer notre patrimoine de données brutes en un actif certifié, auditable et actionnable, garantissant ainsi l’excellence de nos données et notre transition vers l'IA.

TA FUTURE CONTRIBUTION 

En tant que Senior Data Steward , tu seras un référent clé en Gouvernance des données pour les membres de la communauté fédérée. Tu joueras un rôle pivot dans la définition, le déploiement et l’amélioration continue des standards de gouvernance, avec un focus sur les sujets de Data Knowledge et/ou Data Quality.

Ton temps sera partagé entre :

- L'accélération de la feuille de route centrale du CoE Data Governance : définition des standards stratégiques (Data Governance by Design, référencement des exigences de qualité métier, pilotage centralisé de la qualité des données, intégration des exigences de gouvernance dans le projet Data Contract de la Data Platform, et développement du Data Knowledge / Context Layer, etc.).

- L'accompagnement d'une Digital Unit / Domaine Métier (Supply Chain, Commerce, Digital Sports ou Corporate Operations) et d'équipes Pays : piloter la pratique de Data Stewardship, accompagner la montée en maturité, co-définir et piloter la trajectoire des OKR stratégiques (ex: 95% des données critiques respectant leur seuil de qualité) et animer la communauté.

TES RESPONSABILITÉS 

Tu vas pousser l'organisation vers l'excellence dans l'exécution de la gouvernance et de la qualité des données par tous les moyens nécessaires, notamment :

- Définir et faire évoluer le cadre de Data Governance :

- Unified Trust & DQ Metrics Store : Participer à la structuration du Data Quality Metrics Store pour offrir une vision unifiée et transparente de la santé des données.

- Gouvernance & Data Contracts : Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe Data Platform pour veiller à ce que les exigences de gouvernance, de sécurité/conformité (classification, PII) et de qualité soient nativement intégrées dans le projet Data Contract ( "Define once, apply everywhere" ).

- Data Knowledge & Context Layer : Structurer la connaissance technico-fonctionnelle dans le catalogue de données (Collibra) et promouvoir la couche de contexte ( Context Layer ) pour faciliter la découvrabilité et le lignage des données.

- Shift-Left & Remédiation : Déployer le modèle de responsabilité partagée avec les producteurs de données ( Quality by Design ) et standardiser le suivi des plans de remédiation.

- Soutenir une Digital Unit / Domaine :

- Diriger et accompagner la pratique fonctionnelle et technique du Data Stewardship au sein d'une verticale dédiée.

- Réaliser des formations techniques et méthodologiques auprès des Data Stewards, Data Owners et producteurs.

- Évaluer la maturité Data Governance du domaine et piloter les trajectoires vers la certification des actifs critiques.

- Apporter un support au quotidien et participer au recrutement des futurs coéquipiers.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. title: Head of FDE Learning Programs
description:
About Mistral 

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the job

Mistral is hiring a Head of FDE Learning Programs to build the learning system for one of the company’s fastest-growing organizations. Mistral is scaling its FDE organization from its first hire to several hundred Deployment Strategists and Applied AI Engineers within two years. Your mandate is to make capability grow as fast as headcount without lowering the bar for customer work.

You will own: 

- Learning content: Build practical learning across three areas: technical skills, strategic and business capabilities, and product enablement.

- Onboarding: Build a clear path from a new hire’s first week to independent customer work.

- Technical bootcamps: Turn new products, research, and field methods into practical training for customer work.

- Strategic bootcamps : Empower client-facing teams of FDEs to drive business and strategic discussions and to set up for success large partnership programs with customers

- Program ownership: Own the roadmap, curriculum, contributor model, regional delivery, tools, measurement, and central team.

- Scaling: Launch useful programs now, then adapt them for larger cohorts without making the content generic or relying on a small group of experts.

- Team building: Launch the first programs, build a network of instructors, and hire the team needed to support several hundred FDEs.

- Cross-functional work: Work with functional managers, Product, Engineering, Science, People, GTM Enablement, DevRel, and regional leaders.

- Readiness standards: Ensure FDEs in every region meet the same standard, can find current material, learn from recent customer work, and understand expectations at the next career level.

- Knowledge structuration: Ensure internal resources are up to date and pushed to the right stakeholders with a knowledge management approach.

How We Work in Solutions 

- We care about people and outputs.

- What matters is what you ship, not the time you spend on it

- Bureaucracy is where urgency goes to vanish. You talk to whoever you need to talk to. The best idea wins, whether it comes from a principal engineer or someone in their first week.

- Always ask why. The best solutions come from deep understanding, not from copying what worked before

- We say what we mean. Feedback is direct, timely, and given because we care.

- No politics. Low ego, high standards.

- We embrace an unstructured environment and find joy in it.

About you

You have helped build a learning, enablement, or capability function for a technical organization during rapid growth. You can start as the first dedicated owner, deliver useful programs immediately, and build the team and operating model needed to serve several hundred people.

- 

- You are technically fluent enough to work credibly with AI engineers, Product, and Science, inspect the substance of a program, and challenge material that is unclear or outdated.

- You have designed programs that work across cohorts, regions, and experience levels without reducing the content to generic training.

- 

- You can lead work across senior stakeholders, subject-matter experts, managers, and operational partners without relying on reporting lines.

- You can make firm trade-offs when hiring demand, expert capacity, and program quality compete for attention.

- You pay attention to the full learner experience, including communications, scheduling, practice, feedback, and manager follow-through.

- You use evidence to decide which programs to expand, revise, or stop.

- You communicate clearly with executives, managers, technical experts, and learners.

- You are fluent in English and can work with teams across regions and time zones.

Ideally, you have

- Scaled a one-person or small learning function into a team and program that served hundreds of technical employees.

- Built onboarding that kept pace with rapid hiring in an engineering, FDE, solutions, consulting, or professional-services organization.

- Designed and operated technical bootcamps or other cohort-based learning programs.

- Worked in technical DevRel, developer education, or a related role built around demos, code examples, workshops, and practitioner communities.

- Built role- and level-based curricula connected to skills frameworks or career progression.

- Managed a global program with contributors and learners across multiple regions.

- Worked closely with Product, Engineering, Science, People, and customer-facing teams.

- Designed practical assessments, readiness standards, or certification where appropriate.

- Used learning platforms, knowledge systems, AI coaches, or program-operations tooling.

- Worked in AI/ML or another technically complex and fast-changing field.

Why this role matters

Mistral is compressing years of organization growth into two. An FDE organization of several hundred people cannot depend on manager-by-manager onboarding, one-off sessions, and informal access to experts. If learning capacity trails hiring, ramp times would lengthen, standards would diverge, and teams would repeat the same mistakes across regions.

This role will build the programs, teaching network, and systems at the same pace as the organization. Two years from now, success would mean several hundred Deployment Strategists and Applied AI Engineers working from shared standards, learning new capabilities quickly, and improving the system with evidence from customer work.

What We Offer 

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page .

Privacy Policy 

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy .

title: (Senior) Consultant (w/m/d)  Evidenzbasierte Politikberatung im Bereich Hochschul- und Bildungspolitik
description:
Die Technopolis Group ist ein internationales Forschungs- und Beratungsunternehmen für den öffentlichen Sektor mit über 300 Kolleg*innen an zwölf Standorten in Europa, Afrika und Lateinamerika – knapp 50 davon in Deutschland und Österreich. Wir begleiten – oft als externe Evaluator*innen – Politikinstrumente wie z.B. Förderprogramme in verschiedenen Themenfeldern. Wir sind ausschließlich für öffentliche Institutionen und Stiftungen auf regionaler, nationaler und internationaler Ebene tätig.

Unser Team „Education and Skills“ arbeitet aktuell schwerpunktmäßig im Bereich Forschung und Transfer sowie Studium und Lehre an Hochschulen, teils auch in anderen Sektoren des Bildungssystems. Wir analysieren Politikinstrumente etwa zum Aufbau von regionalen Transfer- und Innovationspartnerschaften, zur Kooperation von Wissenschaft und Praxis, zur Internationalisierung sowie Digitalisierung von Forschung und Lehre und der Förderung von Entrepreneurial and Future Skills (z.B. im Bereich MINT). 

Aktuell suchen wir berufserfahrene Kolleg*innen , mit denen wir die genannten Felder weiter ausbauen können. Auch Bewerbungen von Personen mit Erfahrung in der Politikberatung in angrenzenden Themenfeldern wie Forschung und Innovation oder Regionalpolitik/-entwicklung sind grundsätzlich willkommen.

Gemeinsam mit Ihren zukünftigen Kolleg*innen bei Technopolis und unseren Projektpartner*innen konzipieren, akquirieren und leiten Sie Projekte für Kunden wie Bundes- und Landesministerien (z.B. BMFTR , BMWE, BMBFSFJ), die Europäische Kommission (z.B. DG EAC, DG RTD, DG EMPL) sowie Organisationen wie z.B. den DAAD oder Stiftungen. 

Ihre Aufgaben - Wissenschaftsbasierte Beratung öffentlicher Institutionen mit Fokus auf Analyse, Evaluation und Monitoring, Strategieentwicklung und Implementierung von Politikmaßnahmen 
- Erstellung von adressatengerechten Berichten und Präsentationen auf der Basis eigenständiger konzeptioneller und empirischer Arbeit (z.B. Datenauswertungen, Surveys, Interviews, Fokusgruppen) im Team mit unseren Kolleg*innen
- Projektmanagement oder - leitung, inkl. der Führung von Projektteams und dem Kontakt zur Kundenseite
- Projektakquise (Konzeption und Erstellung von Angeboten für existierende und neue Kundenkreise) sowie Vernetzung mit Kooperationspartner*innen und anderen relevanten Akteur*innen

Ihr Profil - Mindestens vier Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung sowie Projektleitungserfahrung im Feld der Politikberatung und/oder Evaluation
- Erfahrung in der Akquise von Beratungs- und Auftragsforschungsprojekten für Organisationen in unserem Arbeitsumfeld
- Abgeschlossenes Studium in einem relevanten Fachgebiet, belastbare empirische Methodenkenntnisse
- Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Selbständigkeit sowie eine analytische und verbindliche Arbeitsweise 
- Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen (z.T. auch internationalen) Dienstreisen
- Sehr gute Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch, weitere Sprachen von Vorteil
- Routinierter Umgang mit Microsoft Office, Kenntnisse quantitativer und qualitativer Analyseprogramme (insb. R oder Stata, aber auch Python, Atlas.TI, o.ä.) von Vorteil.

Unser Angebot - Wir bieten durch die enge Projektzusammenarbeit mit öffentlichen Institutionen ein sinnstiftendes und gesellschaftlich wirkungsvolles Arbeitsumfeld. 
- Wir bieten eine unbefristete Anstellung in Voll- oder Teilzeit in einem wachsenden Unternehmen. Zuschüsse zur Nutzung umweltfreundlicher Mobilitätsarten (ÖPNV oder Jobrad), für eine Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft sowie die betriebliche Altersversorgung runden das Angebot ab. 
- Wir ermöglichen eine flexible Arbeitsweise mit attraktiven Arbeitsplätzen sowie Home-Office-Möglichkeiten durch mobilfähige Ausstattung (MacBook & iPhone). 
- Als innovatives Unternehmen fördern wir die Weiterentwicklung unserer Mitarbeitenden über interne und externe Fortbildungsangebote. Wir fördern Selbstständigkeit und Eigeninitiative für den Ausbau und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Aktivitäten durch flache Hierarchien und eine offene Unternehmenskultur. 
- Wir legen Wert auf eine angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre und leben dies z.B. durch ein kollegiales, vertrauensvolles Miteinander, aber auch z.B. regelmäßige Teamevents, inkl. Events aller Kolleg*innen der Technopolis-Büros weltweit. Wir pflegen den Austausch mit unseren Schwesterbüros in Europa, Afrika und Lateinamerika. 
- Technopolis ist ausschließlich in Besitz der Mitarbeitenden , externe Investore*innen gibt es bei uns nicht. Perspektivisch können alle Mitarbeitende Anteilseigner*innen der Technopolis Group werden. Unabhängig hiervon partizipiert unser gesamtes Team regelmäßig am Unternehmenserfolg. 
- Auch wenn Sie nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllen, bewerben Sie sich gerne. Vielleicht sind genau Sie die richtige Person für diese Stelle. Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen daher alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion/Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität. 

Weiteres Verfahren Wir freuen uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen. Bitte laden Sie Ihre deutschsprachige Bewerbung (Anschreiben, Lebenslauf ohne Foto, relevante Zeugnisse sowie eine Textprobe) auf unserer Webseite unter Angabe Ihrer Standortpräferenz und Gehaltsvorstellung sowie Wunscharbeitszeit und frühestmöglichen Einstiegsdatum hoch. Für Fragen wenden Sie sich bitte an unsere Recruiting Assistentin Susann Reinsch (susann.reinsch_AT_technopolis-group.com). 

Bewerbungsschluss ist der 30 . September 2026. Bewerbungsgespräche können bereits vor Bewerbungsschluss geführt werden.

title: Full-Stack Engineer (Front-End Leaning)
location: Bulgaria,  Ireland,  Netherlands,  Poland,  Portugal,  Sweden,  UK,  USA
description:
About ElevenLabs 

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- 
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- 
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- 
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

- 
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- 
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- 
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- 
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- 
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

- 
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- 
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- 
Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- 
Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- 
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- 
Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role 

We are looking for Full-Stack engineers to develop and maintain both front-end and back-end components of our product suite.

Your general responsibilities will include: 

- 
Building and maintaining the front-ends for our platform and products, which are built on top of our cutting-edge voice models and used by millions of users.

- 
High degrees of ownership. You will be responsible for shipping end-to-end features across the front and back ends of our stack, as well as helping set the direction of the features and products you're working on.

- 
Collaborating closely with others on the Engineering, Growth and Sales teams to understand, and design solutions for, our customer and internal team’s most important problems and workflows.

We believe in pairing engineers with work that matches their strengths and interests. This means that there is significant flexibility in staffing engineers across the company. 

Specific responsibilities might include: 

- 
Improving our existing products to ensure that they’re intuitive, powerful and make innovative use of our research team’s latest break-throughs. This could involve making sweeping UX changes, adding significant functionality, or building integrations with other common consumer/enterprise solutions.

- 
Designing & developing clean, intuitive, and functional user interfaces for products that will be used by millions of users and the world’s largest enterprises.

- 
Working with internal teams and customers directly to synthesize feedback, understand user’s issues, and then design improvements and features to solve them.

Requirements 

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic software engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or GitHub contributions. We do require:

- 
Experience with Web Development using Typescript/React

- 
Familiarity with common software and system design patterns and infrastructure including APIs, cloud infrastructure tools, storage solutions, data structures etc.

- 
Interest in UI/UX design

Location 

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:

Senior Software Engineer 

AccuLynx is a fast-growing SaaS provider of business management software for roofing contractors. With more than 10 years in the business and impressive year-over-year revenue growth, we have quickly established ourselves as the leading software product in this multi-billion dollar industry.

AccuLynx is actively looking for smart and passionate Senior Software Engineers to join our growing Engineering team! We are headquartered out of Beloit, WI and would love to have you join us for major planning sessions and meetings, but this role has the option to be remote. We do not hire based on buzzwords or popular acronyms. We expect you to have mastered at least one language and be eager to master any technology or language in the future. If you want to be part of a collaborative team committed to providing a best-in-class software user experience, please read on!

What You Will Do:

- Support Engineering team in delivering well-written, well-tested code to complete new features or address issues in the product

- Collaborate on the design, implementation, testing and review of new features and fixes

- Review code and contribute feedback to improve the quality, readability, and testability of the code base across Engineering

- Architect, design, develop, deploy and operate services that serve AccuLynx’s thousands of users

- Use Agile process to experiment and improve on software development practices at AccuLynx

What might you work on?

- Implement real time communication tools to connect our customers.

- Create a fast and responsive work-scheduling application for use in the field.

- Build an automation platform so our customers can customize their workflow to reduce wasted movement.

- Solve advanced mapping and geolocation problems.

- Build out our public RESTful API.

- Review junior Engineering team members’ work for accuracy and provide coaching and feedback

- Perform other related duties as assigned

Your Qualifications:

- Top notch coding skills

- 7-10 years of software development experience

- 7+ years of full-stack web development: frontend, backend and database

- Smart and gets things done

- Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills

- Belief that performance is a feature

- Experience with our stack: Vue.js, C#, Sql Server, Redis, ElasticSearch, Git

- Confidence you will make a difference in our product

- Leverages AI-powered development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) to accelerate coding, testing, and debugging workflows while maintaining high code quality standards

- Actively evaluates and integrates emerging AI coding assistants into the team's development process, sharing best practices to improve overall engineering velocity

Bonus Points If You Have:

- Familiarity with Agile methodologies.

- Understanding of HTML5 and mobile responsive development.

- Contributions to OSS projects or Stackoverflow.

- Availability for after hours support. We work at a sustainable 40h/week pace but sometimes things go bump in the night.

Why We Love AccuLynx:

AccuLynx’s success as the #1 business management software for roofing contractors over the past 11 years is thanks to us investing in our employees, maintaining company values and focusing on a strong company culture. Our positive work environment has allowed us to retain employees that have been with us since our company’s inception and has provided the solid groundwork for us to develop an industry-leading product while exceeding our customer’s expectations. Because of our commitment to our company values and culture, we were recently officially recognized as a Great Place to Work Certified™ organization, with 90% of our employees naming AccuLynx as a great place to work.

We’re proud to regularly be recognized for software, product and company culture achievements. Our team’s shared belief in AccuLynx's mission promotes a culture of collaboration, innovation and fun. We have built a benefits program to match the strength of our team. This program includes:

- Attractive compensation packages

- Flexible paid time off - 3 weeks off in your first year!

- Competitive health coverage (medical, dental, vision)

- 401K matching and safe harbor contributions

Our Interview Process:

We do not hire based on buzzwords or popular acronyms. We expect you to be a master of your domain and be eager to learn any technology or language in the future. We aim to reply to your application within a week of receiving it. Our interview process consists of several stages, each one allowing us get to know you better, professionally and technically. It is also an opportunity for you to gain a better understanding of our culture and the work we do at AccuLynx. The stages include:

- CV, open source code, or public portfolio review

- Phone interview with HR team

- Face to Face conversation with a few members of your team.

Applicants must be able to work legally within the United States. Please, no 3rd party inquiries.

All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, or other legally protected characteristics.

title: Backend Engineer, Observability
description:
About the Job: 

LaunchDarkly is looking for a Backend Engineer to help build and expand Vega, our AI-powered platform that surfaces insights and automates actions across LaunchDarkly products. This is a greenfield opportunity: you'll help evolve Vega from an Observability-focused assistant into a cross-product platform that serves Feature Management customers and powers a new, usage-based SKU.

You'll build the APIs, services, and agent infrastructure that make Vega and the whole Observability platform broadly valuable—enabling capabilities like AI-driven dashboard creation, flag cleanup automation, and safe, sandboxed agent execution. You'll work primarily in Go services and data pipelines at significant scale, and collaborate closely with product, design, and other engineering teams to shape how AI capabilities land across LaunchDarkly. Additionally, you'll work on other Enterprise-grade capabilities for the Observability platform to help drive customer activation and success.

Responsibilities:

- Design, build, and ship backend features across the Vega platform (APIs, Go services, agent infrastructure, and data pipelines)

- Own features end-to-end: from prototype and API design through production rollout and iteration

- Operate high-throughput data systems and keep them reliable, performant, and cost-efficient at scale

- Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and engineers across Observability and Feature Management

- Participate in architecture discussions and technical design reviews, contributing to sound trade-off decisions

- Write well-tested, maintainable code and promote best practices for quality, observability, and reliability

- Mentor teammates and contribute to a collaborative, high-trust engineering culture

- Participate in on-call rotations and take ownership of production reliability for your features

What You'll Work On 

- Expand Vega beyond Observability into Feature Management, including the flag cleanup agent as a cross-product capability

- Design and operate safe, sandboxed AI agent execution infrastructure—isolation, resource limits, permissions, and auditability

- Support enterprise capabilities for the Observability platform: building data import and export pipelines to connect O11y to other platforms and enabling new customer workflows

- Build a platform that other teams can contribute to—defining contribution patterns, shared services, and APIs for agent capabilities

- Power dashboard creation via natural language prompts, extending existing Vega infrastructure with new tools, context, and evaluation

- Build the metering and usage pipelines that enable a usage-based monetization model for Vega

- Contribute to architecture decisions, code reviews, and engineering standards across the Observability and Vega teams

About You:

- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping production-quality backend systems

- Proficient in Go (or a similar language like Java, Rust, or C++) and experienced designing APIs and distributed services

- Experience building or integrating LLM-powered features, agents, or AI-driven workflows

- Experience with data-intensive systems—streaming pipelines, columnar stores (e.g., ClickHouse), or high-volume ingest is a strong plus

- Strong product instincts: you care about how your systems are used and can translate ambiguous requirements into clean, well-scoped solutions

- Collaborative and communicative—you work well across teams and functions, and you're comfortable navigating ambiguity

- Familiarity with LaunchDarkly, feature flagging, or observability tooling is a plus

- Experience with usage-based product surfaces, sandboxing/isolation technologies, or developer tooling is a plus

Pay: 

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 3: 

- Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $171,200 - $235,400**

- Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $154,100 - $211,860**

- Zone 3: All other US locations - $145,500 - 200,090 **

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location. 

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas. 
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary. 

About LaunchDarkly: 

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations. 

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

- Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages

- Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts

- Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize

- Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types

- Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

At LaunchDarkly, we believe in the power of teams. We're building a team that is humble, open, collaborative, respectful and kind. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. LD invites any applicant to review our written Affirmative Action Plan. To do so, contact People Ops at hr@launchdarkly.com . 

Do you need a disability accommodation? 

Fill out this accommodations request form and someone from our People Operations team will contact you for assistance. 

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, LaunchDarkly recruiters will only contact you from @ launchdarkly.com email addresses or via LinkedIn from "Verified Recruiter" accounts. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate LaunchDarkly recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before making a job offer. LaunchDarkly will never make a job offer without conducting a formal interview process. Our interview process does not involve asking detailed questions by email. If you are ever unsure about a communication that you receive, don't click any links—visit Careers | LaunchDarkly directly for confirmed job openings and links to apply.

Please notify us of any fraudulent representation by sending an email to careers@launchdarkly.com .

title: Stage - Contrôle de Gestion & Data / Performance (H/F)
description:
Chez Withings, nous souhaitons redonner aux individus le contrôle de leur santé.

Nous avons l’obsession de créer des produits beaux et intuitifs, afin que chacun puisse les utiliser facilement au quotidien; nos balances connectées, montres hybrides, tensiomètres, moniteurs de sommeil et tous les dispositifs de notre gamme sont aujourd’hui utilisés par des millions d’utilisateurs.

Notre objectif : permettre la prévention, le dépistage et l’accompagnement d’un certain nombre de maladies chroniques via des produits et des services innovants, afin de révolutionner la manière dont on prend soin de notre santé . 

Rattaché(e) au Responsable Contrôle de Gestion, vous serez au cœur du pilotage de la performance et de la structuration de la donnée financière. Vous ferez le lien entre les équipes opérationnelles et la finance : analyser, fiabiliser et automatiser l'information pour aider les équipes à décider vite et bien, sur la performance commerciale comme sur les dépenses d'exploitation.

Au-delà du contrôle de gestion classique, vous contribuerez directement à nos chantiers data : construction d'une base CA/Marge unifiée et automatisation des reportings récurrents. Un vrai terrain de jeu pour un profil qui aime croiser finance et outils.

Missions 

1. Analyse de la performance commerciale et du forecast

- Assurer l'analyse hebdomadaire des installations, du sell-out et des stocks distributeurs.
- Mettre à jour ces données dans notre outil de planification Anaplan et alerter sur les principales variations.
- Participer aux revues mensuelles de forecast avec les équipes commerciales pour analyser la cohérence et les écarts au budget.
2. Suivi de la performance opérationnelle et des OPEX

- Aider l'équipe finance à déployer le suivi des dépenses d'exploitation (OPEX) par service.
- Analyser et présenter les suivis OPEX aux responsables budgétaires, avec un vrai rôle d'alerte sur les dérives.
3. Automatisation et fiabilisation du reporting

- Contribuer à la construction et à la fiabilisation de notre base de données CA/Marge (réconciliation multi-sources SAP et e-commerce).
- Automatiser des reportings récurrents (Net Margin, OPEX, Flash Finance) via requêtes et outils dédiés.
- Participer aux analyses liées aux nouveaux flux : migration Shopify, partenariats B2B et nouveaux projets d'intégration.
4. Gestion des outils et analyses ad-hoc

- Assurer la collecte, la mise à jour et la fiabilité des données dans nos outils de pilotage.
- Réaliser des analyses ponctuelles pour les autres services : prévisions d'installations pour le service client, estimation des volumes des nouveaux produits, etc.
Requirements 

- Étudiant(e) en école de commerce, d'ingénieur ou cursus finance / data, en césure ou en fin d'études, avec une première approche du contrôle de gestion et un vrai intérêt pour la donnée.
- Excellente maîtrise d'Excel : formules avancées, TCD, modélisation.
- Appétence forte pour la data et l'automatisation. Des notions de SQL et / ou Python sont un vrai plus et pourront être développées pendant le stage.
- La connaissance d'Anaplan et/ou SAP est un atout.
- Organisé(e) et rigoureux(se), vous gérez plusieurs sujets en parallèle.
- Autonome et curieux(se), vous prenez des initiatives et apprenez vite.
- Excellent(e) communicant(e), vous aimez le travail en équipe et savez interagir avec des interlocuteurs variés.
- Vous parlez couramment anglais.
Benefits 

Rejoindre l’aventure Withings, c’est :

- Intégrer un des pionniers et leaders mondiaux de la santé connectée, plusieurs fois primé au Consumer Electronic Show
- Contribuer à des projets innovants et ambitieux pour la santé de demain dans un environnement agile et en constante évolution
- Intégrer une entreprise internationale, membre de la FrenchTech 120, dont les équipes sont basées à Issy-les-Moulineaux, Boston, Hong-Kong et Shenzhen
- Participer à l’amélioration continue de nos produits et services en les bêta-testant avant leur sortie, notamment lors de nos nombreuses sessions sportives entre collègues
- Bénéficier de nombreux avantages : Stock Options, smartphone et ordinateur de votre choix, réductions pour des activités culturelles et sportives, restaurant d’entreprise, et bien plus encore
- Collaborer avec des collègues passionnés et célébrer ensemble chacune de nos réussites !

title: Satellite Data Processing Engineer
description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth. 

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role: 

Image Quality Support (IQS) makes sure Planet's imagery meets that bar. We sit between imaging operations, satellite operations, software engineering, and the business — close enough to engineering to build our own tools, close enough to customers to know what "quality" means to them.

We have created a new career path at Canonical for Performance Engineers who bring exceptional clarity to software performance, correctness and efficiency. We are adding these roles to every engineering team at the company.

As an open source platform, we have teams that work at every level of the software stack - from the kernel up through server and desktop applications, all the way to the web. We are adding roles with this focus in every engineering team in the company, to act as drivers of performance engineering skills, tools, culture and insights to our entire product range . We have also created a central performance engineering team, where we will drive shared tools, dashboarding capabilities, measurement frameworks, analytical capabilities and skills. We call this career focus ' percorr ' because we have found that the same deep insights that enable sophisticated performance measurement and design also enable teams to improve their harnesses and frameworks for correctness. Understanding not only the application, but the runtime, the compiler, and the system, all the way down to the CPU, gives an engineer the ability to think creatively and with insight about the right things to measure, and the right ways to verify correctness. We have found that performance engineers will often improve the deepest and trickiest areas of our test harnesses, and unblock their teams to test and measure previously 'dark' aspects of their work.

We also have teams that work with every major silicon vendor and cloud, with a particular emphasis on performance optimisation of the entire stack for that architecture, CPU family or hypervisor. Our goal is to ensure that Ubuntu users can select whatever platform they want for their workloads and know they have access to the very best performance and efficiency across the entire stack from kernel to codec.

Our performance and correctness leads are expected to be truly exceptional individuals, and also leaders who are confident setting expectations of change, sharing insights and skills, running initiatives and programs. title: Lead Android Engineer
description:
About Us: 

Future is building a personalized guidance system for lifelong health. We help people understand what to do next for their body, goals, and stage of life — then support them in turning those decisions into sustained behavior change. By combining AI, human expertise, personal health data, and accountability, Future helps members improve performance today while building the resilience, capacity, and healthspan they need for decades to come.

About the Role: 

We’re hiring a Lead Android Engineer to set the technical direction for Future’s Android products and build the experiences our members use every day.

You’ll lead work across our phone and Wear OS apps. You’ll shape core journeys such as onboarding, coach messaging, scheduling, guided workouts, progress tracking, health-data integration, and video calls. You’ll work with product, design, backend, and iOS engineers on a small, senior team.

This is a hands-on role. You’ll move between product details and system architecture, write production code, guide technical decisions, and help other engineers do their best work.

What You’ll Own: 

- Member Experience: Lead Android implementation for the experiences that connect members with their coaches and help them follow through on their plans. Build polished, accessible interfaces with Jetpack Compose and Future’s design system.

- Android Architecture: Set direction for a multi-module Kotlin codebase built around Compose, coroutines and flows, dependency injection, and unidirectional state. Improve module boundaries, data ownership, navigation, and offline behavior as the product grows.

- Connected Health and Wearables: Guide the systems that connect Future with Wear OS, Health Connect, heart-rate data, sensors, and the Android device lifecycle. Protect member data and design for intermittent connectivity.

- Reliability and Performance: Own app startup, responsiveness, media playback, foreground services, background work, real-time calls, and data synchronization. Use crash, performance, and release telemetry to find problems before members encounter them.

- Engineering Excellence: Set expectations for code quality, testing, observability, and maintainability. Strengthen unit, integration, UI, and end-to-end coverage with JUnit, Robolectric, Espresso, and Appium.

- Delivery and Release Quality: Improve Gradle builds, GitHub Actions, Fastlane automation, and Google Play delivery. Help the team ship often without trading away stability.

- Team Leadership: Lead the Android team through technical planning, project execution, design discussions, pairing, and code review. Keep engineers aligned on priorities, decisions, and delivery risks.

- AI-Assisted Development: Use coding agents and AI tools to speed up exploration, implementation, testing, and review. Apply engineering judgment to validate their output before it reaches members.

Who You Are: 

Experience and Background 

- You have 8+ years of professional Android engineering experience, including ownership of complex consumer applications.

- You have deep Kotlin knowledge and a strong command of Jetpack Compose, coroutines, Flows, dependency injection, and Android lifecycle behavior.

- You have led architecture work in a large or modular Android codebase.

- You have shipped and supported applications through Google Play.

- You understand performance, offline state, background execution, media playback, permissions, and device fragmentation.

- You have strong testing habits across unit, integration, UI, and end-to-end layers.

- You can debug across UI, networking, persistence, services, devices, and CI.

- You have led complex projects from planning through launch, partnering with product and design while managing scope, dependencies, risks, and delivery.

- You have operated at lead scope, regardless of title.

- You use AI coding tools in your development workflow and know how to verify their output.

Domain Passion

You care about health, fitness, and the role that thoughtful coaching can play in someone’s life.

Working Style

- You care about interaction quality, accessibility, performance, and the small details members notice.

- You make architectural decisions based on product needs and operating constraints.

- You raise concerns early and bring possible solutions.

- You share context, invite feedback, and help other engineers grow.

- You take ownership from product discovery through production support.

Nice to Have 

- Experience building Wear OS applications or working with the Wearable Data Layer.

- Experience with Health Connect, health sensors, or Bluetooth devices.

- Familiarity with HIPAA and other laws and regulations that apply to health products and services.

- Experience with Media3, CameraX, foreground services, or real-time audio and video.

- Experience designing offline-capable applications with Room, WorkManager, and background synchronization.

- Experience with fitness, health, coaching, or other personalized consumer products.

- Experience evolving a design system across a large Compose application.

Compensation, Benefits & Life at Future: 

- Salary range: $190,000-$230,000 / year + equity. The salary range is set based on multiple considerations including business needs, market demands, talent availability, experience, and unique skills and attributes. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. 

- Health coverage: All employees have access to comprehensive medical, vision, dental, and disability insurance + tax savings accounts 

- 401(k) plan

- Flexible Paid Time Off

- Future Membership: Enjoy our platform for free! 

- Health, Wellness & Development: Health and fitness monthly stipend contributes to our employees’ overall wellbeing, with access to a mental health platform, reimbursement for medical travel, and an annual learning & development stipend. 

- Remote First: Employment eligible to employees located anywhere in the continental US. No travel required. 

- Join a diverse, passionate & driven team of all backgrounds.

Life at Future 

Equity: Meaningful equity package.
Health Coverage: All employees who meet eligibility requirements receive comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and disability insurance, plus tax-advantaged savings accounts.
Retirement: 401(k) plan.
Wellness: Monthly wellness stipend for fitness, recovery, and overall wellbeing, plus access to mental health resources and therapy support.
Flexible Time Off: Flexible PTO so you can rest, recharge, and take care of life outside of work.
Learning & Development: Annual budget for courses, conferences, coaching, and tools that help you grow in your craft.
Future Membership: Enjoy our platform for free.

Equal Employment Opportunities at Future 

We are committed to building a future where every member of our community, is healthy, cared for, and advancing forward together. Future is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, age, civil or family status, disability or race.

title: Team Lead, Platform Engineering
description:
About Volta 

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

About The Role 

Volta builds and operates large scale GPU compute infrastructure for AI workloads. Our platform is Kubernetes-native, spans multiple regions, and delivers virtual machines, storage, and networking through a fully automated infrastructure stack.

Platform Engineering is organized as capability teams, each owning a defined part of the stack: compute, storage, the control plane and API layer, confidential computing, networking, and the customer-facing surface. You will lead one of them.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You set technical direction for your team's area, carry accountability for what it delivers, and manage the people doing the work. You are expected to stay close enough to the code to take on the hard problems yourself.

What You Will Be Doing 

- Lead a platform engineering team: technical direction, design reviews, code review, and day-to-day delivery.

- Set the technical direction for your team's area of the stack, and design and build the platform layers it owns as product requirements take shape.

- Represent platform engineering in roadmap planning: translate product requirements into scoped, sequenced technical work, communicate trade-offs, and keep delivery on track.

- Work closely with the bring-up teams to surface operational pain points and turn them into scalable platform features.

- Collaborate with the security engineering team to integrate security guidance at the platform layer and ensure findings are remediated effectively.

- Coordinate with the other platform engineering leads on shared architecture, joint initiatives, and cross-team and cross-timezone delivery.

- Own reliability, observability, security, and interface and versioning standards for the services your team ships.

- Stay hands-on: take on complex or high-risk engineering work directly alongside the team.

- Run post-mortems and close structural gaps after incidents, not just the immediate issue.

- Manage the team: 1:1s, performance conversations, hiring interviews, and onboarding.

What You Bring 

- 5+ years in cloud platform or infrastructure engineering, with at least 2 years leading an engineering team.

- Strong backend or systems programming background in a production environment. Our working languages are Python, Go, and Rust; we welcome strong engineers from other compiled or object-oriented languages (for example C++, C#, or Java) who are ready to work across our stack as it evolves.

- Kubernetes at depth: cluster operations, CNI networking, scheduling, and workload management in production.

- GPU infrastructure experience: provisioning, resource allocation, and surfacing capacity through a platform or API layer.

- Solid networking fundamentals: L2/L3, VLANs, overlay networks, and multi-tenant isolation in cloud environments.

- Service architecture skills: designing, operating, and versioning production-grade control-plane services and APIs across IaaS and above, holding the team to clean, industry-standard interface and breaking-change practices.

- Security awareness: trust boundaries, least privilege, and secure defaults when building platform services.

- Proven people management: running 1:1s, delivering performance feedback, and taking accountability for a team's delivery and wellbeing.

- Clear communicator who can translate technical complexity for product and leadership stakeholders.

Nice to Have (But Not Essential) 

None of these are required. Several map to specific teams, so strength in one or more helps us match you to the right one:

- Fluency with AI-assisted development, and interest in scaling agent-assisted workflows across the team (agentic CLI tools, MCP, skills, APIs) to amplify delivery.

- Familiarity with confidential computing technologies: TEEs, AMD SEV, Intel TDX, or Confidential Containers (CoCo).

- Experience building SaaS or PaaS layers on top of an IaaS platform.

- Familiarity with RDMA, InfiniBand, or RoCE networking in GPU or HPC clusters.

- Experience working distributed across time zones with counterparts in other regions.

- Exposure to serverless or inference serving infrastructure.

REQ-14

What We Offer 

At Volta, we believe people do their best work when they feel supported, trusted and able to grow. We're building a company where you can make an impact, keep a healthy balance between work and life, and build a career you're proud of. 
As a global team, we do our best to provide great benefits wherever you're based. While some benefits vary by country due to local regulations, we believe looking after our people is simply the right thing to do.

- Competitive salary based on the work you do here, not your previous salary

- Equity in Volta, giving you the opportunity to share in the company's long-term success

- Retirement/pension contributions

- Comprehensive health, wellbeing and insurance benefits

- Generous number of vacation days each year

Additional Information 

Background Checks 

All offers of employment at Volta are conditional on the satisfactory completion of pre-employment screening, which includes confirmation of your right to work, verification of your employment history and a criminal record check, where this is permitted by local law. Screening is carried out by Zinc, an accredited third-party provider, after an offer is made and all information is handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection law.

Equal Opportunity 

Volta is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and make employment decisions based on skills, qualifications, experience and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic.

Accessibility 

Volta is committed to providing an accessible recruitment experience for all candidates. If you require accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the application or interview process, please contact us at 

Candidate Privacy Notice 

By applying, you consent to the processing of your personal data for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the UK GDPR, EU GDPR and relevant US state privacy regulations. Your data will be shared only with those involved in the hiring process and will not be used for unrelated purposes. For details, see our Recruitment & Candidate Privacy Notice.

Note to Recruitment Agencies 

Volta does not accept unsolicited CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies. Any unsolicited submissions, including those sent directly to hiring managers or employees, will be treated as the property of Volta. No agency fees will be payable unless a valid, signed recruitment agreement is in place, and the agency has been specifically engaged for the relevant vacancy.

title: Backend Engineer, AI (Agent Systems)
description:
About ActAI 

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

Role

As a Backend Engineer, AI, you own the inference and orchestration layer that powers every AI interaction in the product. Your work sits between models and users, where latency, correctness, reliability, and cost directly impact real-world experience.

You will build and operate production systems that turn model capability into fast, stable, observable APIs used across mobile and desktop clients.

Focus 

- Build and operate backend systems that serve AI-powered features in production.

- Design inference pipelines, orchestration layers, and service boundaries around models.

- Own production concerns: monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response.

- Optimize latency and throughput across inference, caching, batching, and streaming.

Ideal Experiences 

- Strong backend engineering fundamentals in production environments.

- Experience running high-throughput, low-latency services.

- Familiarity with AI inference patterns (LLMs, embeddings, multimodal).

- Comfortable debugging distributed systems under load.

- Bias toward shipping and learning from production behavior.

Outcomes 

- Backend systems run reliably at scale, handling production AI traffic with low latency and high throughput.

- APIs are stable, clear, and support seamless integration with frontend and ML systems.

- Production incidents are quickly detected, diagnosed, and resolved, minimizing user impact.

- Iterative improvements based on real usage continuously increase system performance and reliability.

Tech Stack 

- Python

🐙 Kraken Generation Flex

The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation, at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves at the heart of it. In the UK, with a legally binding Net Zero target for 2050 and a clean-power ambition for 2030, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid.

Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. With complete independence from Octopus Energy, we are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. As our UK fleet grows and we support our expansion across Europe, we are looking for a Senior Integrations Engineer to lead the deep technical build that turns customer sites into market-connected, controllable assets.

🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary

As we scale our fleet of integrated assets, we are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer to take ownership of the new and unique challenges, whether that's a change to our design or an entirely new type of asset integration.

You’ll be part of an engineering delivery team, based in Manchester, who take an integration project from the very early information stage, design how it will be integrated into Kraken’s platform and then turn that design into a live, controllable, market-participating asset.

Engineering delivery is an innovative and engineering-focused team with a culture that fosters collaboration and fresh thinking to create a new energy system. Alongside design, deployment and testing; they constantly look into ways to improve efficiency through tooling and the automation of repetitive tasks. They collaborate daily with delivery managers and customer success to onboard new sites as well as support the existing.

🚀 What you'll own

- Integration design ownership & review: With minimal oversight, analyse provided information to formulate hardware and software integration approaches. When necessary, exchange information with customer technical representatives through meetings and emails. Review and discuss integration designs, considering the remainder of the integration cycle with other team members.

- Technical leadership & decisions: Make well-reasoned technical decisions and trade-offs for the wider team, provide technical advice on discussions that affect other teams or the company at large, and own the new and unique challenges, a change in our design or a completely new type of asset integration, driving them independently from start to finish.

- Domain expertise (SME): Be the point of contact/SME for at least one technical area. This could include knowledge of grid regulations (G99, G100, Grid Code etc.), energy markets, multi BMUs, industrial communication protocols, industrial networking, internet of things, cyber security and so on.

- Gateway application & configuration: The role will be interdisciplinary. There will be opportunities to learn how the Gateway software (developed by an internal software team) works and how it is configured. You will be expected to understand the requirements for an integration and judge if the gateway software is able to support it or will need new development work. The team will help you get gateway configuration literate and you will be expected to carry out deployments and changes as necessary.

- Networking and cyber security: Develop hardware and network connectivity designs, constantly thinking about our own cyber security posture as well as addressing the concerns from the customers with the support of the internal security team.

- Site testing & commissioning: Get involved in deployment and testing to understand how the commissioning and go-live works. Over time, you will be expected to carry this independently as we may need to flex at times due to the increase in the onboarding demand.

- Incidents & compliance: Be comfortable with addressing the engineering help requests from other teams and with the incident command in the case of issues at the existing sites.

- Business-facing & growth: Support client delivery in meetings with the clients to understand the integration challenges in advance. Aid with the expansion into the EU markets by looking into asset types and integration technologies.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party

- Understanding of the Regulations: Strong understanding of the UK Grid Code, G99 the other liabilities of a grid connected asset before participating in the energy markets.

- Understanding of the UK Energy Markets: Strong understanding of the NESO ancillary services (Dynamic Containment / Moderation / Regulation, Firm Frequency Response), the Balancing Mechanism, and the DNO connection/integration process.

- Technical judgement: Ability to make and justify well-reasoned technical decisions and trade-offs for the wider team, and to take a problem in hand, create a solution framework, agree it with the team and implement it.

- Power plant systems: Strong ability to analyse single line diagrams for a given power plant to understand the site architecture for the points of metering and control instrumentation.

- Asset integration: Experience integrating BESS (grid-scale and/or C&I) and/or RES (Wind and Solar) for telemetry and control.

- Integration design: Ability to produce clear integration designs and design documentation, set standards and patterns, and review others' designs.

- Hardware and Networking: Experience with control systems deployments and their connectivity including the local networking and cyber security aspects. The ability to debug site connectivity and networking issues that includes 4G routers and firewalls.

- Industrial Communication Protocols: Strong practical experience with Modbus (TCP/RTU), plus one or more of IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61400-25, OPC-UA or DNP3.

- CAD, Diagrams and Tools: Experience or familiarity with CAD tools such as AutoCAD or BricsCAD, Miro and Notion.

- Communication & mentoring: Ability to communicate technical decisions through design docs, tech talks and Notion, and to mentor more junior engineers with constructive feedback and guidance.

- Commissioning landscape: Strong understanding of the other parties involved in site commissioning for power plants, their roles and responsibilities, and how we work with them.

- Engineering background: Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control, Software, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience in industrial/energy integration.

- Travel: Willingness to travel to customers and sites although travel is very occasional. Awareness of site safety is required as we may work with site personnel even though we are remote.

- You are a driver and an owner: you take on the hard, ambiguous problems and see them through. You think bigger picture and process, are risk-aware and warn peers in advance, lead on safe working, and are trusted by customers as a technically competent, safe pair of hands. You actively grow the people and the practices around you, and you advocate for the Engineering team within Kraken and beyond.

⭐️ Bonus points

- Wider knowledge of grid compliance (G99, G100, Grid Code) and where the Kraken system fits in.

- Experience with AWS IoT Greengrass or similar edge-deployment architectures.

- Familiarity with software/scripting and templating (e.g. Python, Rust, the Linux command line) and Git-based workflows.

- Understanding of IT/OT security in the energy sector (IEC 62443, NCSC CAF, NIS Regulations awareness).

- Exposure to wider European balancing markets / ENTSO-E frameworks and TSO integrations.

title: Head of Security
location: New York, New York, New York, United States
description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering , Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

- Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security. 
- Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation. 
- Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do. 
- Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
- Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it. 
- Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team. 

What You'll Bring

- Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth. 
- Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook. 
- An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code. 
- Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling. 
- Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you. 
- Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus. 
- Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus. 

What's Cool About The Role

- You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team. 
- A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders. 
- We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it. 
- Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity. 
- Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas. 
- Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

- Model Calibration & Triangulation: Help calibrate our MMM outputs using results from incrementality testing. You will actively use ground-truth experimental data (e.g., GeoX tests, attribution model). 

- Budget Scenario Planning: Translate model outputs into actionable simulation tools and optimization scenarios. You will help stakeholders answer critical "what-if" questions regarding budget reallocations and product splits. 

- User Data & Performance Analytics: Use SQL to deep-dive into first-party user data and tracking key KPIs.

- Data Quality & Pipeline Ownership: Collaborate with our Data Engineering teams to automate data ingestion pipelines, ensuring high-quality, model-ready inputs from ad-platforms, attribution tools, and internal databases.

- Python (or R) proficiency: Solid programming foundations for data manipulation (pandas, numpy), statistical modeling, and machine learning (we primarily use Python). 

- Strong SQL skills: Comfortable writing efficient, structured queries to extract and aggregate massive datasets from relational databases. 

- MMM Frameworks: Exposure to or strong interest in modern open-source MMM libraries (e.g., Meta's Robyn, Google's Meridian, or PyMC/Bayesian workflows). 

- Solid foundation in econometrics, time-series analysis, and regression modeling (OLS, Ridge/Lasso, Bayesian regression). 

- Good understanding of testing and experimentation methodologies (A/B testing, GeoX testing, hypothesis testing, and statistics like MDE and bias analysis). 

- A keen interest in marketing dynamics (customer acquisition, CAC, CPA, ROI, and media attribution).
